decisive_items: remote history of laryngeal squamous cell carcinoma (7 years prior)
soft tissue mass with increased vascularity surrounding the device
response.rationale: The vignette describes a painless, hypervascular soft-tissue mass at the pacemaker site with infection and hematoma excluded, in a patient with past squamous cell carcinoma. The specific history of laryngeal squamous cell carcinoma and the exclusion of infection/hematoma favor metastatic squamous cell carcinoma over the broader metastatic disease or the alternative urothelial origin, which lacks direct supportive context.
